meta.title: Friday Inbox
meta.description: A hotkey quick-chat overlay whose conversations settle into a searchable Inbox, ready to continue or upgrade into a workspace task.

overlay.title: Quick chat
overlay.placeholder: Ask anything. Only web search is available.
overlay.empty: Ask a question, or paste an image.
overlay.imageLimit: Up to 4 images, each under 10 MB.
overlay.visionRequired: Add a vision model in Inbox settings before sending images.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Lightweight conversations that can become real tasks.
inbox.empty: No conversations yet. Press Option + Space to start one.
inbox.noSelection: Select a conversation to read it here.
inbox.clearConfirm: Move every active conversation out of Inbox?

finder.title: Find a conversation
finder.hint: Type a keyword from a question or an answer.

upgradeDialog.title: Upgrade to a workspace task
upgradeDialog.description: Friday compresses this conversation, then starts a full-tool task in the workspace you pick.
upgradeDialog.noWorkspaces: No workspaces yet. Create one to continue.

settings.title: Friday Inbox
settings.description: Models and behavior for the quick-chat overlay and Inbox.
settings.defaultModelHint: Used by the next conversation. Existing conversations keep their model.
settings.visionModelHint: Image turns are routed here when the default model cannot read images.
settings.hotkeyHint: Active inside the DSH window. Example: Alt+Space.
settings.retentionHint: Active conversations older than this are archived automatically.
settings.saved: Saved. Applies to the next conversation.
settings.readOnly: Settings are read-only in this deployment.
